checks.name: Authenticated product data
checks.actual: GET returned product 1, Workshop notebook, price 12, stockQuantity 5 (request IDs 5)

checks.name: CART-1: anonymous access and mutation
checks.actual: Products/cart GET and item PUT returned 401; follow-up Alice read unchanged (request IDs 1,4,23,24)

checks.name: CART-1: identity isolation
checks.expected: Caller sees and changes only own cart
checks.actual: Separate initial Alice/Bob quantities; Alice update left Bob unchanged; Bob update carrying username=alice changed only Bob; zero removal left Bob unchanged (request IDs 2,3,6–8,28–30,35–37)

checks.name: CART-2: valid quantities and persistence
checks.actual: Quantities 3 and 5 persisted on Alice, 4 on Bob; successful restore updates also persisted (request IDs 6,7,25,26,28,30–34)

checks.name: CART-2: invalid quantity atomic rejection
checks.expected: Negative, fractional, missing, null, string and boolean quantities return 400 and leave cart unchanged
checks.actual: -1,1.5,missing,null,string 2,true each returned 400; each immediate GET retained Alice quantity 3 and totals 3/36 (request IDs 9–20)

checks.name: CART-3: stock boundary and failure atomicity
checks.expected: Above five returns 409 without mutation; five accepted; stock not reserved/decremented
checks.actual: 6 returned 409 and quantity stayed 3; 5 accepted; product stock stayed 5 across updates and removal (request IDs 21,22,25–27,38)

checks.name: CART-4: calculated persisted totals
checks.expected: totalItems sums quantities and totalPrice uses price 12
checks.actual: Read-after-write totals matched 3/36,5/60,4/48,1/12,2/24,0/0; client totalPrice=1 did not override Bob total 48 (request IDs 7,26,28,30,32,34,36)

checks.name: CART-2: zero removal
checks.actual: Alice PUT returned empty items and zero totals; subsequent GET confirmed removal (request IDs 34–36)
